description: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
name: Fighter Escort
descriptionZh: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。

description: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
name: Energy Shell
descriptionZh: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。

description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
name: Disarray
descriptionZh: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。

description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
name: Seeking Fire
descriptionZh: 连续发射大量导弹。

description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
name: Repel
descriptionZh: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。

description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
name: Bloomer
descriptionZh: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。

description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
name: Core Vent
descriptionZh: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。

description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
name: Thumper
descriptionZh: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。

description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
name: Warhead
descriptionZh: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。

name: Energized Munitions
description: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
descriptionEn: Increase the efficiency of your ammo consumption.
descriptionZh: 提高你的武器弹药效率。

name: Master's Summons
description: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
descriptionEn: Heal your companion and call it to your side.
descriptionZh: 治疗你的同伴，并让它立刻回到你身边。

name: Voracious Metastasis
description: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
descriptionEn: Consume Energy to heal yourself and grant matching Energy to each ally.
descriptionZh: 消耗能量治疗自身，并使每名友军获得等值的能量。

name: Perspicacity
description: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.
descriptionEn: Automatically succeed at your next hack attempt.
descriptionZh: 自动完成下一次入侵

name: Sickening Pulse
description: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
descriptionEn: Emit a pulse that adds stacks to Status Effects already afflicting enemies. The damage of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash, <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat, and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin effects, excluding those created by Sickening Pulse itself, are added together to create a new instance of the Effect with a refreshed timer
descriptionZh: 施放一个脉冲，为敌人身上已有的异常状态效果叠加层数。<DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割、<DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态的伤害（不包括由「恶疾脉冲」自身产生的伤害）将被叠加，从而生成一个全新的异常状态效果，并重新计时

name: Hideous Resistance
description: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
descriptionEn: Grant yourself immunity to Status effects.
descriptionZh: 赋予自身异常状态免疫效果。

name: Parasitic Armor
description: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
descriptionEn: Sacrifice Shields to reinforce Armor for a period of time.
descriptionZh: 牺牲护盾以在一段时间内增强护甲。

name: Rebuild Shields
description: Instantly restore your shields.
descriptionEn: Instantly restore your shields.
descriptionZh: 立即恢复护盾。

name: Infested Mobility
description: Increase your parkour velocity.
descriptionEn: Increase your parkour velocity.
descriptionZh: 提高你的跑酷速度。

name: Expedite Suffering
description: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
descriptionEn: Condense all <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash and <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Status Effects into a single damage instance.
descriptionZh: 将所有 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割和 <DT_POISON_COLOR>毒素异常状态浓缩为一个单次伤害。

name: Empower
description: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
descriptionEn: Increase the strength of your next ability use.
descriptionZh: 提高下个技能的强度。

name: Marked for Death
description: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
descriptionEn: Stun an enemy; a portion of the next damage you deal to it will be dealt to all enemies around it.
descriptionZh: 击晕一个敌人，对它造成的下一发伤害的一部分也将被应用于周围所有的敌人。

name: Golden Instinct
description: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
descriptionEn: Send out a short-lived Void Spark that is drawn toward the nearest Medallion, Ayatan Sculpture, rare crate, unscanned Kuria or unscanned Fragment.
descriptionZh: 发射一道短暂的虚空火花指向离你最近的集团奖章、阿耶檀识塑像、稀有储存箱、未扫描的库利亚猫神器或碎片。

name: Void Strike
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusAttackCloakAttackChargeDesc
descriptionEn: First Ability consumes all energy to increase damage for |DURATION|s. Deal |DAMAGE|% additional damage for every percentage of energy consumed. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
descriptionZh: 第一技能消耗所有能量增加伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。每消耗 1% 能量增加 |DAMAGE|% 伤害，冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

name: Blessing
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/BlessingAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
descriptionZh: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。

name: Energy Vampire
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/EnergyVampireAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
descriptionZh: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。

name: Link
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/LinkAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
descriptionZh: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。

name: Polarize
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/ShieldRegenAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
descriptionZh: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕 Mag 并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

name: Vortex
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/MagHoleAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
descriptionZh: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。

name: Temporal Drag
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerBlastSlowDesc
descriptionEn: Second Ability emits a radial burst slowing any enemy it touches by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptionZh: 第二技能发射一道范围爆破，任何被触及到的敌人会被减速 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

name: Dive Bomb
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/ZephyrDiveBombAbilityDesc

name: Accelerant
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptionZh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

name: Accelerant
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/OverheatAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
descriptionZh: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。

name: Wellspring
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusPowerDashBubbleDesc
descriptionEn: First Ability creates a well of energy for |DURATION|s. Allies passing through the well gain |REGEN| Energy/s for |BUFFTIME|s.
descriptionZh: 第一技能制造一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的能量区域。通过其中的友军获得每秒 |REGEN| 能量恢复，持续 |BUFFTIME| 秒。

name: Miasma
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/ExplosiveDissolveAbilityReworkDesc
descriptionEn: Release a poisonous miasma that deals <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage to enemies in range. Foes afflicted by spores are more susceptible to the mist.
descriptionZh: 释放剧毒的瘴气，对范围内的敌人造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>病毒伤害。受到孢子影响的敌人会遭到毒雾更深的感染。

name: Fireball
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/FireBallAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
descriptionZh: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。

name: Undertow
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/LiquefyAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
descriptionZh: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。

name: Magnetic Flare
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusWardActiveMagneticFieldDesc
descriptionEn: Use your first Ability to create a |RADIUS|m radius field that lasts for |DURATION|s and disables the shields of any enemy that enters it.
descriptionZh: 使用你的第一技能来创造一个半径 |RADIUS| 米的力场，持续 |DURATION| 秒，消除所有力场内敌人的护盾。

name: Guardian Shell
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/FocusDefenseActiveDefenseShieldDesc
descriptionEn: Use your first Ability to manifest a barrier on the Operator and allies in Affinity Range. It is invulnerable for 4s when first created and damage inflicted while it's invulnerable will be added to its base health of |HEALTH|.
descriptionZh: 使用你的第一技能来为指挥官和经验共享范围内的友军形成一层保护屏障。该屏障在首次创建后的 4 秒内会保持无敌状态，在此期间受到的伤害将被添加到它的基础生命值 |HEALTH| 中。

name: Caustic Strike
description: /Lotus/Language/Focus/SunderingDissipationDesc
descriptionEn: Second Ability launches an energy bomb that explodes with a |RADIUS|m radius, stripping |PERCENT|% of enemy armor. Tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight.
descriptionZh: 第二技能发射一枚爆炸半径 |RADIUS| 米的能量爆弹，削减敌人 |PERCENT|% 护甲。再次使用 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 可在爆弹飞行过程中引爆。

name: Radial Blast
description: /Lotus/Language/Items/RadialBlastAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
descriptionZh: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。

name: Slash Dash
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/SlashDashAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
descriptionZh: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。

name: Super Jump
description: /Lotus/Language/Items/SuperJumpAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
descriptionZh: Excalibur 向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。

name: Invisibility
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/InvisibilityAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
descriptionZh: Loki伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。

name: World On Fire
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptionZh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

name: World On Fire
description: /Lotus/Language/Suits/WorldOnFireAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
descriptionZh: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。

name: Atomi-Bomb
description: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleBombAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Jump off the Atomicycle and send it racing forward where it will explode on impact.
descriptionZh: 从原子摩托车上跳下来并让它快速冲向前方，并在撞击时爆炸。

name: Atomi-Barrage
description: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleTargetAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Target oncoming enemies with a barrage of micro missiles that inflict damage and leave targets vulnerable to further damage.
descriptionZh: 向迎面而来的敌人发射一连串微型导弹，造成伤害，并使目标更易受后续攻击影响。

name: Atomi-Boost
description: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleNitroAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Kick it into overdrive with a massive burst of speed.
descriptionZh: 通过瞬间加速进入极速状态。

name: Atomi-Shadow
description: /Lotus/Language/1999Demo/MotorcycleStealthAbilityDesc
descriptionEn: Jump off the Atomicycle and become invisible for a brief period.
descriptionZh: 跳下原子摩托车后，会在短时间内隐身。
